name: Uncollateralized Overnight Call Rate (policy rate)
notes: BoJ target policy rate. Hiked to 0.50 Jan2025; 0.75 Dec2025; 1.00 Jun2026.

name: JGB Yield 1-Year
notes: MoF reference interest rates (daily) aggregated to monthly.

name: JGB Yield 2-Year
notes: MoF reference interest rates.

name: JGB Yield 5-Year
notes: MoF reference interest rates.

name: JGB Yield 10-Year
notes: Benchmark long-term rate.

name: JGB Yield 30-Year
notes: Super-long maturity.

name: Inflation Expectations 1-Year (composite)
notes: Tankan 'Outlook for General Prices' 1 year ahead; average of all enterprises all industries.

name: Inflation Expectations 3-Year (composite)
notes: Tankan 'Outlook for General Prices' 3 years ahead; average of all enterprises all industries.

name: Inflation Expectations 5-Year (Tankan enterprises' outlook)
notes: Tankan 'Outlook for General Prices' 5 years ahead; average of all enterprises all industries. The Tankan has no 10-year horizon so this longest survey horizon deflates the 10Y yield.

name: Real Interest Rate 1-Year (ex-ante)
notes: Nominal 1y minus 1y expected inflation. 2005+ reference (ex-ante).

name: Real Interest Rate 3-Year (ex-ante)
notes: Medium real rate (3y interpolated). 2005+ reference (ex-ante).

name: Real Interest Rate 10-Year (ex-ante)
notes: Long real rate. 2005+ reference (ex-ante).

name: Real Policy Rate (policy rate minus 1y expected inflation)
notes: Real ex-ante policy rate. Compared with the natural rate to gauge the policy stance.

name: Real Interest Rate 1-Year (ex-post)
notes: Headline real 1y: nominal minus realized core CPI. Scored over longest history (1974+).

name: Real Interest Rate 3-Year (ex-post)
notes: Headline real 3y (2y-5y interp minus realized core CPI). Scored over longest history (1974+).

name: Real Interest Rate 10-Year (ex-post)
notes: Headline real 10y: nominal minus realized core CPI. Scored over longest history (1986+).

name: Average Contracted Interest Rate on New Loans
notes: Average contracted rate on new loans and discounts; domestically licensed banks. BoJ Data Search IR04.

name: CP Issuance Rate (3-month a-1 rated)
notes: NO LIVE SOURCE: the Bank's CP yield series (FM02 STRACP3M) was discontinued after October 2009. Candidate replacement is IR04 DLLR2CIDBNL2 (new short-term loans and discounts). Seeded until chosen.

name: Corporate Bond Spread (AA 10y over JGB)
notes: NO LIVE SOURCE at the Bank; issuance spreads are published by JSDA/Bloomberg rather than the BoJ Data Search. Seeded.

name: Tankan Lending Attitude DI - Large Enterprises
notes: DI = accommodative minus severe. Positive = accommodative.

name: Tankan Lending Attitude DI - Small Enterprises
notes: DI = accommodative minus severe. Positive = accommodative.

name: Tankan Financial Position DI - Large Enterprises
notes: DI = easy minus tight. Positive = easy.

name: Tankan Financial Position DI - Small Enterprises
notes: DI = easy minus tight. Positive = easy.

name: TOPIX Index
notes: Broad equity index. Higher = more accommodative (balance-sheet/wealth channel).

name: Nikkei 225 Index
notes: Headline equity index.

name: USD/JPY Exchange Rate
notes: Higher USDJPY = weaker yen = more accommodative for exporters/profits.

name: Bank Lending Outstanding (y/y %)
notes: Lending by domestic commercial banks (avg amounts outstanding) y/y.

name: CP and Corporate Bonds Outstanding (y/y %)
notes: No BoJ Data Search match found for CP and corporate bonds outstanding; seeded pending a source.

name: Core CPI (ex-fresh food) y/y
notes: MIC CPI core (ex-fresh food). Context for 2% target.

name: Potential Growth Rate
notes: BoJ staff estimate. Key driver of natural rate in structural models.

name: Natural Rate of Interest - Lower Bound
notes: Min across 6 models. ~-0.9pct as of 2025Q3.

name: Natural Rate of Interest - Midpoint
notes: Midpoint of 6-model range. ~-0.2pct as of 2025Q3 (range center).

name: Natural Rate of Interest - Upper Bound
notes: Max across 6 models. ~+0.5pct as of 2025Q3.

name: Real Policy Rate (ex-post vs realized core CPI)
notes: Monetary conditions: ex-post real policy rate (policy rate minus realized core CPI). Lower = easier. History from 2004.

name: Money Stock M2 (y/y %)
notes: Broad money growth (BoJ Money Stock). Faster growth = easier monetary conditions; a leading inflation signal in the 'money view'.

name: Money Stock M3 (y/y %)
notes: Broadest money aggregate growth (BoJ). Secondary to M2.

name: BoJ Total Assets (y/y %)
notes: Balance-sheet stance: expansion (QQE) = easier; contraction (JGB-purchase taper from Aug-2024) = tighter.

name: Real Effective Exchange Rate (BIS broad; 2020=100)
notes: Classic MCI input. Higher REER = stronger yen = tighter monetary conditions (polarity -1).

name: Monetary Base (y/y %)
notes: Central-bank liquidity: base money growth (BoJ). Negative since 2024 as the balance sheet shrinks.

name: BoJ Current Account Balances (y/y %)
notes: Reserves held at the BoJ (excess reserves). Growth = more system liquidity.

name: Overnight Call Rate minus Policy Target (pp)
notes: Funding liquidity / rate control: TONA trading above target signals reserve scarcity or funding stress (polarity -1).

name: 3m TIBOR minus OIS (pp)
notes: Bank unsecured funding premium. Wider = tighter funding liquidity.

name: USD/JPY 3m Cross-Currency Basis (bp)
notes: Dollar-funding cost for Japanese banks; more negative = scarcer dollar liquidity (polarity +1: less negative = easier).

name: JGB Market Functioning DI (BoJ Bond Market Survey)
notes: Degree of bond-market functioning (high minus low; negative = impaired). Fell to -64 in Feb-2023 under YCC; recovering since exit.

name: 10y JGB Bid-Ask Spread (normalized ticks)
notes: BoJ 'Liquidity Indicators in the JGB Markets' style measure. Wider = less liquid (polarity -1).

name: BoJ Share of Outstanding JGBs (%)
notes: Central-bank absorption of the market; higher share = thinner free float, worse market liquidity (polarity -1).

name: Nikkei Volatility Index (%)
notes: Implied equity volatility; spikes coincide with liquidity withdrawal (polarity -1).

name: 10Y JGB Realized Volatility (12m std of monthly changes bp)
notes: Computed from MoF yields. Higher volatility = impaired market liquidity / term-premium stress (IMF GFSR Apr-2026; June-2025 taper slowdown trigger).

name: JGB 10s30s Curve Slope (30Y minus 10Y pp)
notes: Super-long term premium / fiscal-risk gauge from MoF yields. Steeper = more term-premium stress in the super-long zone (polarity -1).
